body: the night shift: two workers from the livestock-feed study carried a sweet chemical smell. the creek smelled wrong before the siren began.
title: the night shift — a sweet chemical smell
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sweet chemical smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
The man writing the names asked what I did for a living. I told him, and he put down something else.

He said the form had no space for my work. I could see there was a space; it was already filled. The person beside me told me to let him finish.

I wrote my own occupation here because I do not want the next person to think I lied about it.
title: The wrong occupation
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
